notes: Canonical measurement against sealed Chunk 31 996/672 registry resolves exactly five existing labels (Dynamic Surroundings, Chunk By Chunk, Atmospheric Phenomena, BetterEnd, Exposure) and five absent canonical labels (Infinity Cave, Multi Mine, Thin Air, Horse Combat Controls, Grappling Hook Mod).
Infinity Cave is Frozytime/Frozeh's cave-system project. Its canonical Modrinth route is datapack-backed but the creator source semantics remain mod.
Multi Mine is AtomicStryker's long-running project; unrelated similarly named mining projects are excluded.
Thin Air is Fuzs's original archived project. Later continuation/port projects are not silently substituted for the creator's 2024 recommendation.
Horse Combat Controls is pitbox46's Mount-and-Blade-style horse-control project.

The creator supplies two project links under one Grappling Hook Mod recommendation: Yyon's original Forge lineage and the Restitched Fabric/Quilt port. They stay one creator-recommended canonical family with both distribution lineages rather than inflating the source to eleven recommendations.
No reupload, unrelated same-name project, later Skybound fork, or Thin Air continuation is included.
